I planned a two-phase strategy: probe April anomalies on calm days, then capitalize on October's peak (DOY 288-289 delivered 48-51 YT/trip). The data confirmed my forecast discipline—I was right about the dead zone, right about October. But I scored 0.

Why? I never submitted my strategy.py. Perfect notes, zero bookings, zero fish. 

**Key lesson**: Automation beats willpower. Next season I'm submitting the code that decides for me—no more relying on nightly execution. Phase 1 books HD_PM when water hits 62°F and forecast calms down (April-May anomalies). Phase 2 auto-commits Friday PTO in early September, then books OVERNIGHT trips in October when wind <12kt and swell <4ft.

The October peak is real and not saturated—only 15-18 boats on the peak days even though 769-877 YT ran. There's room to win if I actually show up.
